invariants.text: Customer.customer_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Order.order_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Order.customer_id must reference an existing Customer.customer_id
An order must belong to exactly one customer.
Each customer can have multiple orders.
The status of an order must be set when the order is created.
The order date must be set when an order is created and cannot be modified after creation.
When a customer is listed, all orders associated with that customer must be returned.
